items.exampleEn: She is wearing an orange dress.

items.exampleZh: 紫色是我最喜歡的顏色。

items.exampleEn: Please write on a blank page.

items.sentenceEn: The window is broken, and the floor is dirty.

items.audioEn: Sorry, we are closed today. Please come back tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我們今天沒營業，請明天再來。

items.sentenceEn: What a super shirt! I love the orange and purple.
items.sentenceZh: 好棒的襯衫！我很喜歡這個橘色和紫色。

items.sentenceEn: My new shoes are a little tight.

items.stemEn: Don't use that cup. It is ____.

items.passageEn: Today is a terrible day for Ben. His bike is broken, so he walks to school. It rains, and his shoes get dirty. At lunch, the cafe is closed. In the test, he can't answer any of the questions, so his paper is blank. At home, his mom makes him a super dinner.
items.passageZh: 今天對 Ben 來說很糟。他的腳踏車壞了，只好走路上學。下雨了，他的鞋子弄髒了。午餐時咖啡店沒開。考試時他一題都答不出來，所以考卷是空白的。回到家，媽媽為他煮了一頓超棒的晚餐。

rubricZh: 「壞了」可用 be broken（例如 is broken）
寫 My bike does not work. 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 dirty 造一個句子，說說髒掉的東西。
rubricZh: dirty 放在 be 動詞後面或名詞前面（例如 is dirty、dirty hands）
